_comment: Fallbacks for fields the home page has no equivalent for — a landing page's offer block and its meta tags. Hero fields are NOT here: their baseline is captured from the live home page. Read by src/data/landing.ts at build time and by the Hero Lab at runtime, so the preview and the built page agree.
